The corridor the agent should have taken is left_edge.

adjusted_prescription: Although the provided demonstrations show successful navigation through central corridors near fire hazards, they do not explicitly teach following the left-edge corridor strategy that was needed. To improve the agent's fire avoidance, it is important to create and use demonstrations where the agent consistently commits to the left-edge corridor as a safe, robust path. These demonstrations should show the agent prioritizing long-term safety by choosing the left-edge path even if it looks less immediately accessible or less direct, especially in cases with randomized fire placements. This approach will help the agent generalize its behavior to avoid risky short-term moves into fire and instead follow safer corridor-based navigation. Incorporating such left-edge corridor-focused demos will strengthen the agent’s ability to navigate reliably in environments with dynamically placed fires.
